title: HtmlP
responsibility: Renders the native p element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlP.attributes
inputs.description: Native p attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlP.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native p element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlP
outputs.description: The actual native p element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
